Has your winner changed character?你的赢家，性质变了吗？

US names near their highs, grouped by how the move is aging.处于高位附近的美股，按行情老化的程度分组。

Priced 2026-10-30价格截至 2026-10-30 Re-read every night每晚重新判读
Three kinds of winner, each read against its own history. A name can be in more than one, so these counts do not add up to a total. A name is listed when it cleared one of the three bars in the last 21 sessions; one that no longer clears its bar today is listed only as Character changed. 三类赢家，各自对照自身历史来判读。 同一只个股可能同时属于多类，因此这些数字不能相加。 个股只要在最近 21 个交易日内达到过三道门槛之一就会列出；今天已不再达到门槛的，只会列在「走势已变」。 ?
How this board is built这块看板是怎么来的 Three groups, one question三个分组，同一个问题
Who is here谁在这里 Every US name that cleared one of the three bars in the last 21 sessions. Each bar includes being within 10% of its highest close in the past year.最近 21 个交易日内达到过三道门槛之一的所有美股。每道门槛都包含收盘价在过去一年最高收盘价 10% 以内这一条。
Counted apart分开计数 A name can clear more than one bar, so it can appear in more than one group. The counts are never added together.同一只个股可能同时达到多道门槛，因此可能出现在多个分组里。各组数字从不相加。
Not a call不是判断 A group describes how a move is behaving today. It is not a call, a target, or a reason to do anything on its own.分组描述的是当下走势的状态。它不是判断、不是目标价，本身也不构成采取任何行动的理由。

Where this comes from这一行的来源 The market around these names这些个股所处的环境
The mood line情绪一句话 Our market-wide froth read, said in plain words. It describes the market these winners live in — it says nothing about any one of them.这是我们对全市场亢奋度的判读，用大白话讲出来。它描述的是这些赢家所处的环境，与其中任何一只个股无关。
Topping count见顶计数 How many US names the stage read already places in a topping phase — a separate, coarser read that runs weekly.阶段判读中已被归入见顶阶段的美股数量 —— 那是另一套更粗略的判读，每周运行一次。

About this group关于这个分组 Big six-month gains半年大涨
The bar入选门槛 Up 50% or more over six months, and within 10% of its highest close in the past year.半年内上涨 50% 或以上，且收盘价在过去一年最高收盘价的 10% 以内。
The order排列顺序 Inside a group, the largest six-month gain comes first. That is a fact about the past — not a ranking.每组内部按半年涨幅从大到小排列。那只是关于过去的事实 —— 不是排名。
Its own history自己的历史 Every mark here is cut from past runs that also cleared this group's bar — never from another group's. The same name can read differently in another group.这里的每一条标准，都取自同样达到本组门槛的历史行情 —— 绝不取自其他分组。同一只个股在另一个分组里，可能读出不同的结果。
What is not read here这里不看什么 A few checks need a longer price history than some names have. Where a check cannot be made, it is not counted as clear — it is simply not counted.有几项检查需要较长的价格历史，部分个股并不具备。无法完成的检查不会被当作「没问题」，它只是没有计入。

The order排列顺序 Inside a group, names run A to Z by ticker so you can find yours. That is not a ranking either.每组内部按代码 A 到 Z 排列，方便你找到自己的持仓。这同样不是排名。
Its own history自己的历史 Every mark here is cut from past runs that also cleared this group's bar — never from another group's. The same name can read differently in another group.这里的每一条标准，都取自同样达到本组门槛的历史行情 —— 绝不取自其他分组。同一只个股在另一个分组里，可能读出不同的结果。
What is not read here这里不看什么 How much a name gained over the past year is left out here — in runs like these it is too weak to lean on. Where any other check cannot be made, it is not counted as clear either.个股过去一年的涨幅在这里不予采用 —— 在这类行情中它太弱，不足以依靠。其他检查若无法完成，同样不会被当作「没问题」。

About this group关于这个分组 Far above trend远高于自身均线
The bar入选门槛 At least six of its own typical daily moves above its 200-day average price, and within 10% of its highest close in the past year.股价高出自身 200 日均价的幅度至少相当于它自己 6 个交易日的正常波动，且收盘价在过去一年最高收盘价的 10% 以内。
The order排列顺序 Inside a group, names run A to Z by ticker so you can find yours. That is not a ranking either.每组内部按代码 A 到 Z 排列，方便你找到自己的持仓。这同样不是排名。
Its own history自己的历史 Every mark here is cut from past runs that also cleared this group's bar — never from another group's. The same name can read differently in another group.这里的每一条标准，都取自同样达到本组门槛的历史行情 —— 绝不取自其他分组。同一只个股在另一个分组里，可能读出不同的结果。
What is not read here这里不看什么 How much a name gained over the past year is left out here — in runs like these it points the other way. Where any other check cannot be made, it is not counted as clear either.个股过去一年的涨幅在这里不予采用 —— 在这类行情中，它指向的方向是相反的。其他检查若无法完成，同样不会被当作「没问题」。
In a very large group the small price chart is left off so the page stays quick — the words beside each name are the same.分组很大时，会略去名字旁边的小价格图，以保持页面轻快 —— 文字部分完全相同。
display only · no rank, gate or position size仅供展示 · 不参与排序、准入或仓位
